source.note: Official: 39 trails, 5 chairlifts (2 high-speed detachables) plus a magic carpet (carpet not counted). 138 acres per official-site/OnTheSnow summary (Wikipedia 160). Terrain-park count from a third-party summary. Lift types (search summary 2026-09-30; skiresort.info https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/bristol-mountain/ski-lifts/): Galaxy Express (high-speed quad, 2009, Doppelmayr, 2,400/h), Comet Express (high-speed quad, 1999, Garaventa, 2,400/h), Morning Star (fixed quad, 2000), Rocket Triple (1984), Sunset Double (1973) — 9,700/h over 5.1 km of lifts. Another result said 4 chairs and 1 surface lift; surface lifts left unknown.

features.beginnerArea: Launching Pad learning area served by a magic carpet; beginner lesson tickets are limited to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair

source.note: Night lighting reported on ~97% of trails (third-party summary). On-mountain lodging left unknown: the research only saw a 'ski & stay' page. Childcare (18 months-12 years) appeared in an unattributed summary — unconfirmed.

character: Compact Finger Lakes ski area south of Canandaigua with about 1,200 ft (366 m) of vertical, large for western New York, on terrain that is fairly steep for the region. Snowmaking covers the whole mountain, most trails are lit for night skiing, and it hosts race and aerials training.
learning: Beginners start at the Launching Pad, a separate learning zone with a magic carpet. Beginner-only 2-hour group lessons run on weekends and holidays at 10am and 1pm; the package bundles a 4-hour lift ticket restricted to the Lunar Launch and Sunset Chair plus a 4-hour rental.

source.note: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends only at first, Comet Express with 3 trails; daily from mid-December). Closed Thu Apr 2, 2026 after 111 operating days per RochesterFirst (https://www.rochesterfirst.com/news/business/local-business/bristol-mountains-2025-26-season-comes-to-a-close/).

season.typicalText: Opened Sat Dec 6, 2025 (weekends at first, daily from mid-December) and on a Thursday around Nov 30, 2023 for its 59th season (date inferred from article dates); the 2024-25 opening date was not found. The 2025-26 season closed Thu Apr 2, 2026 after 111 operating days.
season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening date found as of 2026-09-28. OnTheSnow (third party) projects an opening of 2026-12-11 and closing of 2027-04-04; these are projections, not announcements (https://www.onthesnow.com/new-york/bristol-mountain/ski-resort).

terrain.liftsByType (2026-09-30): 5 chairlifts (skiresort.info) vs 4 chairlifts + 1 surface lift (another search result). Resolution: used 5 chairlifts, matching the official 5-lift total; surface lifts left unknown.
research.confidenceNotes: WebFetch was blocked, so every figure comes from search-result summaries. Base (1,000 ft) and summit (2,200 ft) came from a summary mixing the official About page and a New York By Rail guide. Terrain parks (2) and night-lighting details (97% of trails lit) come from third-party or encyclopedia summaries. The lift ticket page did not show a season label; prices are assumed to be 2025-26. The 2026-27 family pricing ($750/$250) comes from the 2026-27 pricing PDF and an iskiny.com news item. The summit coordinate is an estimate for weather queries only. Season-pass prices ($750/$250 family tiers) belong to passes.json and are not listed here.
